mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_MEMBER ( MEMBER_ID, PASSWORD, MEMBER_NAME, EMAIL, PHONE, STATUS, ROLE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{password}, #{memberName}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{role, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_ID, PASSWORD, MEMBER_NAME, EMAIL, PHONE, STATUS, ROLE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, LAST_LOGIN_AT FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
SELECT MEMBER_ID, PASSWORD, MEMBER_NAME, EMAIL, PHONE, STATUS, ROLE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, LAST_LOGIN_AT FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE EMAIL = #{email}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MEMBER SET MEMBER_NAME = #{memberName}, EMAIL = #{email}, PHONE = #{phone}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
UPDATE TB_MEMBER SET PASSWORD = #{password}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
UPDATE TB_MEMBER SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
